objective: The semantic-merge floor cannot tell a question from its negation. server/services/russell/similarity.ts ~L38 says negations are kept for that reason, but ~L109 scores shared/min(size), so an extra 'not' on one side never lowers the score (overlap('Should we publish the fees report','Should we not publish the fees report') is 1), and ~L78 replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g,' ') turns can't into 'can t' and mangles non-ASCII (Zürich -> rich, café -> caf). clearsFloor gates semantic merges in judgment.ts, so a model can fold an idea into its opposite (CLAUDE.md §24). Fix: tokenise with \p{L}\p{N} and the u flag, map n't to not, and have clearsFloor refuse with a reason naming negation when a negation word (not/no/never/without) appears on exactly one side.
expectedOutcome: A negated rewording no longer clears the merge floor, and non-ASCII words survive tokenisation.

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/russellMergeFloorNegation.test.ts: clearsFloor refuses the 'not' pair and the can/can't pair with a reason naming negation.
contentTokens('Zürich café') contains zürich and café.
tests/russellIntegrationPass.test.ts still passes and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
